SuckerPot network: not joined. You can join later in the dashboard.

Next steps:
  1. Sign in. The setup opens by itself.
  2. Forward the ports listed on the Ports page of the dashboard on your router.
     Never forward the dashboard port (8443) or your admin SSH port.
  3. Install the host firewall: ./scripts/participant.sh firewall (details: docs/deployment.md#host-firewall)
  4. Take a snapshot of the machine.

      warning: Docker Engine 27.0.1 is older than 28. On this engine the internal networks are NOT isolated from the host (the isolation needs gateway_mode_ipv4: isolated, from Engine 28). Upgrading Docker Engine to 28 or newer is strongly recommended.
